values: M11 / W1: Large active oceanic predatory squid; local study shows fish/cephalopod prey and offshore/ontogenetic migrations. Size, high feeding level and oceanic habitat exceed the forage pool. Group6 includes medium Brama australis as pelagic nekton/prey for larger predators, giving a partial active-nekton functional connection. Group7 is a Seriolella demersal species pool; named Hoki/hake are demersal fish predators with equally strong taxonomic mismatch. Benthos rejects predominantly pelagic caught squid; Macrozooplankton is explicitly euphausiids. Group6 is retained as a Very low surrogate, not cephalopod membership. Entire label uses one reviewed source group or analogue; no numerical split. Sources: Neira2026_Table1; SAU_provider; WoRMS; Squid_primary; FAO_squid.
